# ADR template

New decision: copy this block to `decisions/adr-nnnn-<slug>.md`, take the next free number from [[decisions|Decisions]], replace the placeholders, and add a row there.

```markdown
---
title: "ADR-nnnn — <decision in one sentence>"
---
# ADR-nnnn — <decision in one sentence>

**Status:** proposed

**Context:** <the forces that make the decision necessary>

**Decision:** <what holds>

**Rejected alternative:** <what not, and exactly why>

**Consequences:** <what the decision costs and enables>

**To replace:** <only for status `default`: the files and docs this decision owns, and what to change to replace or drop it>
```
